notes.title: Shipset’s Log | It’s Weapons Time! 🔫
notes.notes:
[h2]WEAPONS![/h2] 

Hey everybot, Shipset here! They let me do another one of these logs! So as you may be aware... 

[b]IT’S TWO WEEKS UNTIL LAUNCH!!  [/b]

That’s coming up quick! You should probably start thinkin’ about how you’re gonna take down Evilware and his MASSIVE army. Which [i]meaaaaaaans[/i] you're gonna need some firepower...  

[i][b]Cue the epic shoot-y weapons montage![/b][/i]

[previewyoutube=qbimk-NPsak;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h3][b]BLADE[/b][/h3]
[b][i]BOLT-TO-BOLT COMBAT[/i][/b]

It’s nothing personal... but this weapon is! The Blade is best for when you’re surrounded or have an enemy you can get close to. Get up close with one of Evilware’s goons and- [i][b]WHAM![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/3f00563524a0ed701a46debefa403a90d7b87e5d.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]ASSAULT RIFLE[/b][/h3]
[i][b]OLD FAITHFUL[/b][/i]

Ahhh, a classic. Perfect, no notes – get me 14 of ‘em right now. This one’s tried and true. Focusing on speed over firepower, this will do great in any typical gunfight against a few enemies at a time – but be careful not to overheat it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/eabeb271ec5694eee8a87df01d26efbed7b9eb83.jpg[/img]
 

[h3][b]ROCKET LAUNCHER[/b] [/h3]
[i][b]SHIELD DESTROYER[/b][/i]

A FREAKIN’ [i][b]ROCKET LAUNCHER?![/b][/i]  OHHH this thing is gonna be SUPER handy in destroying those annoying shields! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/ec75a415c5263c9249087fb6cbb56028fb22adf8.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]NANO TURBINE[/b][/h3]
[i][b]AIM, CLICK, DELETE[/b][/i]

One minute they’re there... the next? GONE. Great for picking off targets from a long distance away and dealing BIG damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/be1e69852b7bd2f7fffb92e0615188ff326062fb.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]ACID THROWER[/b][/h3]
[i][b]BOT MELTER[/b][/i]

This one’s [i]spicyyyy[/i] - turn Evilware’s army into BOT SOUP! Going up against a [i][b]GIANT HORDE OF EVIL DINOSAUR ROBOTS?[/b][/i] This thing has a wide spray, so if your aim is a little off, I’d suggest just giving enemies a good hosing down with this thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/dcc8aa977c53c6a6c431cabaeb1dcc42decf1d79.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]LASER GUN[/b][/h3]
[i][b]SUSTAINED DESTRUCTION[/b][/i]

No way... LASERS TOO?! Just hold down the trigger and swing this thing around! Dealing a steady stream of damage – provided you can keep a lock on your target –  this one is a good pick. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/b28029dacb2bd7e4c403301c469e2e024d8b2e01.jpg[/img]
 

[h3][b]AKIMBOS[/b][/h3]
[i][b]DUAL-WIELDING GOODNESS[/b][/i]

Hey, look at me! I’m a cowbot! 🤠 If you’re faster on the trigger and in combat, use these bad boys while spinning circles around enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/a2a572ef734f8b35a00c8df70662e1f51371d1b6.jpg[/img]


SoooOOoooo much to choose from! Now that you’ve met the crew and checked out your arsenal, I’ll show you around next time.  

See ya August 29!  

Bye-bye for now!
[i][b]Shipset[/b][/i]

notes.title: Shipset’s Log | Meet the Characters 👋
notes.notes:
HEY EVERYBOT! Shipset coming at you with my first LOG! The devs are REALLY busy right now, I don’t know if you noticed but... 

[i][b]IT’S AKIMBOT LAUNCH MONTH!!!!!  [/b][/i]

No big deal, no big deal... but GET EXCITED! 

OH how [i]ruuuude[/i] of me! You haven’t been introduced, allow me... 

[previewyoutube=uNpL8pW4u98;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2]MEET THE CHARACTERS![/h2] 

[h3][b]EXE[/b][/h3]
[b][i]MERCENARY / HACKER / BUZZKILL[/i][/b]

Exe may [i]seem[/i] like a total buzzkill... because he is. Heh, he can be a little shy at first, but we’ll bring him out of his shell in no time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/61a5db8727790952ebeb9cb0d7aafdd2268c8611.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]SHIPSET[/b][/h3]
[i][b]ADVANCED AI / KNOW-IT-ALL[/b][/i]

HEY IT’S MEEEEE! [i]Waaait a minute[/i], [b]KNOW-IT-ALL?![/b] Did you mean a delightful bot with [i]the[/i] most extensive internal wiki? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/9e7fd663ebd197e00ef1fc4b135103d4cfb82296.jpg[/img]
 

[h3][b]AMBASSADOR[/b] [/h3]
[i][b]BOSSY BOOTS[/b][/i]

More like [b]AmBOSSYdor[/b], ammiright? The Ambassador is always telling us what to do – something something [i][b]sAvE tHe uNiVeRsE, Exe[/b][/i]! He means well, but wow, does he talk a lot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/d28afc7a7244be9f5cd033f23e3d26c7b13b7ba3.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]EVILWARE[/b][/h3]
[i][b]EVIL EVIL EVIL BOT[/b][/i]

Yeah, this one’s in the name – he's the [b]bad guy[/b]. Probably wasn't hugged enough as a baby bot - would help explain why he's on a warpath to destroying the universe... yikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/f5eef00d8bddb95fc834032a82821b44a4b4444a.jpg[/img]


And that’s the crew! There’s a lot more we’ll find out along the way, so see you on August 29! Looking forward to saving the universe with you! 
 

Signing off,  
[i][b]Shipset[/b][/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/c544aa62cd54de3a6aa657e2b592c810afc74a31.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/fadfa1d891d7a8717a5db3e5e2bcca31e0c8e2b3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Akimbot | Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Akimbot 🤝 Steam Next Fest[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/08bea948adfccec0ccf9148950893ee5902f4519.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Play the Akimbot Demo now![/b][/h3]
It's time to hack, dash, and slash your way through the universe...

[b]Akimbot has a demo featuring in Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/b]

We're so excited for you to begin your adventure with Exe and Shipset. You can play from [b]RIGHT NOW until 18 June, 10am Pacific Time.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843540/Akimbot

Meet the dynamic duo, Shipset and Exe, tasked with saving the universe from impending doom! Piece of cake, right?

The demo starts the way all good adventures do - with a prison break. Stranded in Data Bay, the first planet you explore in Akimbot's robot-filled universe, you'll have to jump, dash, and hack your way out of this paradise! Say hi (or bye...) to the locals, try to resist the inviting beaches, or pull up at one of the dance parties (yes, plural).

Blast your way through armies of robots, control spaceships, and forge your own path on a mission to save the universe!

We'd love to see your favourite moments from the Akimbot Demo - [b]please tag us @Akimbot_Game or #Akimbot it up![/b]

notes.title: Welcome to Akimbot! 🤖
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to Akimbot! 🤖[/h2]
[i][b]Are you ready for robot mayhem and explosive action?[/b][/i]
Well, hold on to your circuits because this 3D action-adventure platformer is PACKED FULL OF THEM!

🔫 Hone your combat style with a huge arsenal of weapons
🪐 Explore a vibrant, unpredictable universe
💥 Hack through ALL kinds of robot enemies

Play as Exe – an outlaw robot venturing through galaxies alongside an unexpected sidekick – Shipset. 

Blast your way through armies of robots, control spaceships, and forge your own path on a mission to save the universe from impending doom! 

Set in a sci-fi world where only robots exist, travel the galaxy and experience non-stop robot mayhem and explosive action!

Your journey begins the way many great stories do – with a prison break.
